fact_text: On 2025-05-05 the State Bank of Pakistan cut its policy rate by 1 percentage point, from 12% to 11%, a move most analysts had not expected.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)

fact_text: In a survey before the decision, 29% of respondents expected a 1% cut and 51% expected no cut; a 50 basis point cut was the modest move some analysts forecast after April CPI.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)

fact_text: The central bank's inflation outlook moved from about 9% to 8%, which the interviewee said was a second factor behind the 1% cut.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)

fact_text: Oil prices fell from about USD 75 a barrel in the previous quarter to about USD 56-57, which the interviewee said gave the central bank room to turn more bullish on the economy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)

fact_text: The World Bank and IMF expected GDP growth of about 2.6-2.7%, while the State Bank's expectation was about 2.5-3.5%, with the second half expected to rebound.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)

fact_text: Agriculture was the likely drag on GDP: growth was about 8% in the prior year but only about 1% in the first half of FY25, and the central bank was hesitant to give an agriculture outlook.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)

fact_text: Large-scale manufacturing figures were weak and negative, which the central bank flagged as a caution alongside trade tariffs and geopolitical tension.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)

fact_text: State Bank reserves fell by about USD 1 billion since the last policy meeting and stood at about USD 10 billion, against a year-end target of about USD 14 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)

fact_text: The interviewee expected inflows after the IMF meeting on 9 May 2025: about USD 1 billion from the IMF, USD 2-2.5 billion from commercial banks and a few million from multilateral agencies.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)

fact_text: On 2025-05-05 the KSE-100 fell about 1,000 points intraday before closing roughly flat, with cement stocks leading the rebound.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)

fact_text: On 2025-05-05 cement stocks led the market rebound and posted good gains, after the policy rate cut, according to the market segment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)

fact_text: The interviewee expected mutual fund conversions into equities to bring liquidity into the stock market after the rate cut, though timing was uncertain.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)

fact_text: The interviewee argued some stocks still offered better yields than the policy rate, so the lower rate would not automatically pull all money out of equities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'SBP springs a surprise, cuts interest rate by 100bps to 11% | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-05)
